bullets.title: “Ep. 1 Ponyo is Here” (_10 Years with Hayao Miyazaki_)
bullets.note:
](https://el2.convertkit-mail.com/c/gku0l36gga5hmmo8ki4/45ivheh9xz3per/aHR0cHM6Ly93d3czLm5oay5vci5qcC9uaGt3b3JsZC9lbi9vbmRlbWFuZC92aWRlby8zMDA0NTY5Lw==)**.** Hayao Miyazaki has been called “the Walt Disney of Japan” (a tag [he has said](https://el2.convertkit-mail.com/c/gku0l36gga5hmmo8ki4/r9f8hoh769p3rm/aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cucmV1dGVycy5jb20vYXJ0aWNsZS91cy1wb255by9qYXBhbmVzZS1kaXJlY3Rvci1taXlhemFraS1zZWVrcy1icmVha291dC11LXMtZmlsbS1pZFVTVFJFNTdCMDNUMjAwOTA4MTI=) is unwarranted because Walt Disney was a business person, and he sees himself as “just a director”). His Studio Ghibli has produced four of Japan's top-five most successful animated blockbusters, including my favorite movie, _Spirited Away_, and _Princess Mononoke_, which beat _The Lost World: Jurassic Park_ when they both hit the big screens in Japan. [This episodic series](https://el2.convertkit-mail.com/c/gku0l36gga5hmmo8ki4/8mtqhoh3re82vq/aHR0cHM6Ly93d3czLm5oay5vci5qcC9uaGt3b3JsZC9lbi9vbmRlbWFuZC9wcm9ncmFtL3ZpZGVvLzEweWVhcnNoYXlhb21peWF6YWtpLz90eXBlPXR2RXBpc29kZSY=) from NHK, the BBC of Japan, chronicles “the creative process of the legendary Japanese filmmaker. He is shown as a passionate artisan, a steadfast trailblazer, and a father butting heads with his son.” Thanks to Stephanie Rosenbloom ([@stephronyt](https://el2.convertkit-mail.com/c/gku0l36gga5hmmo8ki4/l4cehmh4x5pn9r/aHR0cHM6Ly90d2l0dGVyLmNvbS9zdGVwaHJvbnl0)) for sending this to me.

And in related news: “[The Entire Studio Ghibli Library Heads to HBO Max](https://el2.convertkit-mail.com/c/gku0l36gga5hmmo8ki4/dgseh0hkpzxogr/aHR0cHM6Ly9uZXJkaXN0LmNvbS9hcnRpY2xlL3N0dWRpby1naGlibGktbGlicmFyeS1oYm8tbWF4Lw==).” Finally! Hat tip to Sam McRoberts ([@Sams\_Antics](https://el2.convertkit-mail.com/c/gku0l36gga5hmmo8ki4/7na7h8h8nve67d/aHR0cHM6Ly90d2l0dGVyLmNvbS9TYW1zX0FudGljcy9zdGF0dXMvMTE5Njc5MzE0NTU3NDU0MzM2MQ==)) for the heads up. I’ve been waiting decades for this to happen… #pigsareflying

bullets.section: Product I’m using… and reusing… and reusing —
bullets.title: The Able Brewing “DISK.”
bullets.note: I’ve been getting back into coffee, thanks to a few days of hanging with Kelly Starrett ([@thereadystate](https://el2.convertkit-mail.com/c/gku0l36gga5hmmo8ki4/xlhph6hzq8mp62/aHR0cHM6Ly90d2l0dGVyLmNvbS90aGVyZWFkeXN0YXRl)) and Juliet Starrett ([@julietstarrett](https://el2.convertkit-mail.com/c/gku0l36gga5hmmo8ki4/kdumh6hexgp5qv/aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuaW5zdGFncmFtLmNvbS9qdWxpZXRzdGFycmV0dC8=)) of [The Ready State](https://el2.convertkit-mail.com/c/gku0l36gga5hmmo8ki4/2mi2hohgmrx8zz/aHR0cHM6Ly90aGVyZWFkeXN0YXRlLmNvbS8=). The “DISK” is a reusable stainless steel filter for the AeroPress, one of my favorite methods for making coffee. This avoids the waste of disposable paper filters. For beans, I’m using the delicious “[Sidepipe Blend](https://el2.convertkit-mail.com/c/gku0l36gga5hmmo8ki4/gvfnh5hnq72l58/aHR0cHM6Ly9mbGF0dHJhY2tjb2ZmZWUuY29tL3Byb2R1Y3RzL3NpZGVwaXBlLWJsZW5kLXdlYg==)” from Flat Track in Austin, Texas. [Able Brewing](https://el2.convertkit-mail.com/c/gku0l36gga5hmmo8ki4/30tphkhrp682le/aHR0cHM6Ly9hYmxlYnJld2luZy5jb20vY29sbGVjdGlvbnMvcHJvZHVjdHMtMQ==) also makes and sells reusable metal filters for Chemex, alongside other goodies. For more nerdy explorations of coffee, be sure to check out my adventures in [_The 4-Hour Chef_](https://el2.convertkit-mail.com/c/gku0l36gga5hmmo8ki4/4wcvheh9xz3pex/aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuYW1hem9uLmNvbS80LUhvdXItQ2hlZi1Db29raW5nLUxlYXJuaW5nLUFueXRoaW5nL2RwLzEzMjg1MTkxNjMv). (And if the Able Brewing website crashes, try [their store](https://el2.convertkit-mail.com/c/gku0l36gga5hmmo8ki4/rps8hoh769p3ro/aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuYW1hem9uLmNvbS9zdG9yZXMvQWJsZUJyZXdpbmcvbm9kZS83ODI4NzAxMDEx) on Amazon).

bullets.title: A Pickpocket’s Tale: The spectacular thefts of Apollo Robbins
bullets.creator: Adam Green
bullets.note:
([@Adam\_\_\_Green](https://el2.convertkit-mail.com/c/gku0l36gga5hmmo8ki4/d2heh0hkpzxo9z/aHR0cHM6Ly90d2l0dGVyLmNvbS9hZGFtX19fZ3JlZW4=)) (_New Yorker)._ This was sent to me by [Jeffrey Zurofsky](https://el2.convertkit-mail.com/c/gku0l36gga5hmmo8ki4/7lu7h8h8nve62k/aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuaW5zdGFncmFtLmNvbS9qZWZmcmV5enVyb2Zza3kvP2hsPWVu) (“JZ” from [_The 4-Hour Chef_](https://el2.convertkit-mail.com/c/gku0l36gga5hmmo8ki4/lwiehmh4x5pn9x/aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuYW1hem9uLmNvbS80LUhvdXItQ2hlZi1Db29raW5nLUxlYXJuaW5nLUFueXRoaW5nL2RwLzEzMjg1MTkxNjMv).) Here’s one paragraph to give you a taste:

When Robbins hits his stride, it starts to seem as if the only possible explanation is an ability to start and stop time. At the Rio, a man’s cell phone disappeared from his jacket and was replaced by a piece of fried chicken; the cigarettes from a pack in one man’s breast pocket materialized loose in the side pocket of another; a woman’s engagement ring vanished and reappeared attached to a key ring in her husband’s pants; a man’s driver’s license disappeared from his wallet and turned up inside a sealed bag of M&M’s in his wife’s purse.
